historical_comparison.reported_method: controlled perturbation/detection study on the synthetic affine-root fixture
historical_comparison.interpretation: comparison observations only; not reproduced values, solver tolerances, fitted constants, or acceptance gates

new_study.detection_rule: root-shift L2 norm exceeds 10 times baseline float64-vs-mpmath root error, and float64 root-shift discrepancy is at most 10 percent of the high-precision root shift
new_study.uniform_perturbation: all eight state arrays a,b,X,Aa,K,rho,pr,pt receive the same positive smooth shape times each array's own max-absolute scale
new_study.single_component_perturbation: absolute perturbation to midpoint cell of a; explicitly one component choice, not assumed to match historical component selection

summary.single_component: not resolved through 1e-7 absolute perturbation in a[10]
